description: Read, diff and search Java .properties message bundles with \uXXXX escapes decoded.
config.title: Properties Lens
config.bundleGlob: Glob for .properties files. Only groups that have <name>_<locale>.properties siblings are treated as message bundles.
config.primaryLocale: Locale shown inline and in search results (e.g. ko, en, zh_CN). Empty: VS Code display language, then the default file.
config.keyPatterns: Regular expressions that find message keys in source files. Capture group 1 is the key.
config.decorateFiles: Glob of source files that get inline messages, hover and go-to-definition.
config.syncCommand: Shell command that regenerates the message bundles. Empty hides the sync action.
config.syncCwd: Working directory for the sync command, relative to the workspace folder.
config.autoOpenDecoded: Open bundle files in the decoded read-only view automatically.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: In untrusted workspaces the sync command is read only from user settings.
